info.name: Anthony Feghali - Assets, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerabilities
info.description:
Postman collection for the services built by Anthony Feghali: Asset Management, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management.

**Before running:** `python init_db.py` (fresh sample data), then `python run.py`.

Run the folders in numeric order. Setup logs in one test account per role and stores the tokens. No real secrets are stored here.

request.description:
**Author:** Anthony Feghali

Creates a new asset. Status defaults to Active. Criticality is stored as one of Low, Medium, High, Critical, enforced by the API and by a CHECK constraint.

Sent as: admin. Expected status: 201.

  "department": "Sales",
  "owner_id": 1,
  "location": "Beirut HQ, Server Room B",
  "criticality": "High"
}
